notes.title: Rolling Adventure Speed Run mode released
notes.content:
Enabling speed running has been one of the major critics and requests for Rolling Adventure so far. As a result of our team effort, we proudly announce the Speed Run capability available now as part of the game mechanics.

The faster you are to finish puzzles and avoid obstacles, the faster the rolling platform will move.

This new update includes:
[list]
[*] Speed Run mode
[*] Music settings
[*] Language selection auto-save
[*] Levels complexity rework
[/list]

Upcoming feature, the most wanted weapon system ...

Happy new year, everyone!

notes.title: Rolling Adventure - live on Steam August 31st!
notes.content:
Germany-based game developer, Jumit, announces the launch of Rolling Adventure, a classic 2D hard-core tight platformer, after 3 years of development.

Our much-anticipated 2D game, Rolling Adventure, will be officially released on August, 31st, 2021 on the gaming platform Steam. The hard-core tight platformer is a product of 3 years of sleepless nights and hard work from the Jumit team that comprises two devs and one designer, who are highly trained and well-experienced game developers and enthusiasts.

Keep in mind, the biggest challenges bring the biggest rewards, and be sure to add Rolling Adventure to your wishlist NOW!
